Method of Attack: Distributed via YouTube channels masquerading as cracked software installation guides
Uses malicious URLs shortened by TinyURL and Cuttly leading to open-source platforms like GitHub and MediaFire
Initial infection via ZIP file containing LNK file that calls PowerShell to download a private .NET loader
Private .NET loader performs environment checks, anti-VM and anti-debugging techniques, then loads encrypted DLL payload
DLL decrypts and injects Lumma Stealer payload
Stealer targets user credentials, system details, browser data, crypto wallets, and browser extensions
Communicates with multiple command-and-control servers to exfiltrate stolen data
Attack Vector: YouTube videos with malicious URLs in descriptions
ZIP file with LNK file triggering PowerShell to download malware from GitHub
Use of open-source hosting platforms to evade web filter blacklists
